In 2024, an EPSGHAN 3-day monothematic conference on paediatric portal hypertension was held in Dublin (Ireland), gathering international experts in portal hypertension. portal_hypertension.abstract: The hepatology committee of the European Society for Paediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition (ESPGHAN) aims to provide education on key aspects of paediatric hepatology. Here we provide recent developments in the understanding, diagnosis and clinical consequences of portal hypertension (PHT) in children and young people, an area in which evidence remains scarce and fragmented. In 2024, an EPSGHAN 3-day monothematic conference on paediatric PHT, held in Dublin (Ireland), brought together international experts in PHT. portal_hypertension.abstract: This study aimed to characterize immune remodeling following laparoscopic splenectomy and azygoportal disconnection (LSD) in patients with cirrhotic portal hypertension. In this 1-year prospective study, a total of 49 patients with cirrhotic portal hypertension received LSD treatment. We analyzed the dynamic changes in immune function-related indices through serial assessments conducted preoperatively and at 1, 3, 6, and 12 months postoperatively (POM 1, 3, 6, 12), specifically focusing on CD4+ T cell, CD8+ T cell, and CD19+.CD20+ B cell. portal_hypertension.abstract: Transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) is a well-established bridging therapy for the management of severe complications of portal hypertension. However, the impact of long-standing malpositioned TIPS on liver transplantation remains scarcely reported CASE REPORT: A 64-year-old male with alcoholic cirrhosis and refractory hepatic hydrothorax underwent TIPS placement with sustained clinical benefit for nearly 8 years. He later developed refractory ascites and recurrent hepatic encephalopathy and was listed for liver transplantation.
